resources.string: A peer recognition and appreciation activity — happening for the first time across all Sunners. Launching in November 2025, it encourages Sun* members to share recognition and gratitude on the official platform announced by the organizing committee. These submissions will serve as reference material for the Heads Council during the award selection process.

The MVP award honors the most outstanding individual of the year — the defining face representing the entire Sun* collective. They have demonstrated exceptional competence, enduring dedication, and far-reaching influence, leaving a powerful mark on Sun*\'s journey throughout the year. Beyond their performance and results, they are a source of inspiration — through their thinking, actions, and positive impact on the team. MVP embodies all the qualities of an elite Sun* member while carrying a great responsibility: becoming the role model for Sun* people and spirit, helping lead the collective to new heights.

The Best Manager award honors outstanding leaders who have guided their teams to deliver results beyond expectations, making a remarkable impact on business performance and the sustainable growth of the organization. Under their leadership, the team consistently conquers and masters every goal through multitasking capability, effective collaboration, and agile application of technology in the digital era. They inspire the collective to become confident, energized, and ready to embrace — and even lead — revolutionary change.

The Signature award honors an individual or team that embodies the defining spirit Sun* pursues in each era. In 2025, the Signature award recognizes the Creator — an individual or team with a proactive, sharp mindset who sees opportunity in every challenge and pioneers action. They are perceptive problem-solvers who quickly identify issues and deliver practical solutions that create clear value for projects, clients, or the organization. With a creative mindset and Sun*\'s signature \"Creator\" spirit, they not only respond positively to change but proactively drive improvement, helping to shape new standards for how Sun* people create value.

The Top Project award honors outstanding project teams with business results that exceed expectations, optimal operational efficiency, and a dedicated work ethic. These are projects with high technical complexity, excellent resource and cost optimization, valuable ideas proposed to clients, outstanding profitability, and positive client feedback. Members strictly adhere to internal development standards throughout the project, setting a benchmark for excellence and professionalism.

The Top Project Leader award honors outstanding project managers — those who combine strong management capability, powerful inspirational ability, and an \"Aim High – Be Agile\" mindset in every challenge and context. Under their guidance, team members not only overcome obstacles and achieve set goals together, but also sustain their passion, Wasshoi spirit, and grow to become their finest — and happiest — selves.

The Top Talent award honors all-round outstanding individuals — those who consistently demonstrate solid professional competence, exceptional work performance, always delivering value beyond expectations, and highly regarded by both clients and teammates. With a spirit of readiness to take on any mission the organization assigns, they are always a source of inspiration, motivating others and creating a positive impact on the entire collective.
